description: Client-side JavaScript class for managing the Point of Sale item cart interface in ERPNext, including customer selection, cart item management, totals calculation, and keyboard shortcuts.

classes.name: erpnext.PointOfSale.ItemCart
classes.description: Class managing the POS item cart UI, including customer info, cart items, totals, and keyboard shortcuts.

methods.name: constructor
methods.description: Initializes the ItemCart with wrapper, events, and settings.

methods.name: init_component
methods.description: Sets up DOM, child components, event bindings, and shortcuts.

methods.name: prepare_dom
methods.description: Prepares the main DOM structure for the cart.

methods.name: init_child_components
methods.description: Initializes customer selector, cart components, and numpad.

methods.name: init_customer_selector
methods.description: Creates customer selection UI.

methods.name: reset_customer_selector
methods.description: Resets customer selection to default.

methods.name: init_cart_components
methods.description: Creates cart UI including item list, totals, and numpad.

methods.name: make_cart_items_section
methods.description: Creates cart items section and placeholder.

methods.name: make_no_items_placeholder
methods.description: Displays placeholder when cart is empty.

methods.name: get_discount_icon
methods.description: Returns SVG icon for discount.

methods.name: make_cart_totals_section
methods.description: Creates totals section with discount, total, taxes, and checkout button.

methods.name: make_cart_numpad
methods.description: Creates numeric keypad for quantity, rate, discount, and actions.

methods.name: bind_events
methods.description: Binds UI events for customer, cart items, checkout, and shortcuts.

methods.name: attach_shortcuts
methods.description: Sets up keyboard shortcuts for cart actions.

methods.name: toggle_item_highlight
methods.description: Highlights or unhighlights selected cart item.

methods.name: make_customer_selector
methods.description: Creates customer search and selection control.

methods.name: fetch_customer_details
methods.description: Fetches customer info and loyalty points.

methods.name: show_discount_control
methods.description: Displays discount input control.

methods.name: hide_discount_control
methods.description: Hides or updates discount display.

methods.name: update_customer_section
methods.description: Updates customer display info.

methods.name: get_customer_image
methods.description: Returns HTML for customer image or abbreviation.

methods.name: update_totals_section
methods.description: Updates net total, total quantity, and grand total.

methods.name: render_net_total
methods.description: Displays net total.

methods.name: render_total_item_qty
methods.description: Displays total item quantity.

methods.name: render_grand_total
methods.description: Displays grand total.

methods.name: render_taxes
methods.description: Displays tax details.

methods.name: get_cart_item
methods.description: Retrieves cart item element by name.

methods.name: get_item_from_frm
methods.description: Gets item data from form document.

methods.name: update_item_html
methods.description: Updates or removes cart item HTML.

methods.name: render_cart_item
methods.description: Renders individual cart item HTML.

methods.name: handle_broken_image
methods.description: Replaces broken item image with abbreviation.

methods.name: update_selector_value_in_cart_item
methods.description: Updates data attribute in cart item.

methods.name: toggle_checkout_btn
methods.description: Shows or hides checkout button.

methods.name: highlight_checkout_btn
methods.description: Highlights or unhighlights checkout button.

methods.name: update_empty_cart_section
methods.description: Shows placeholder if cart is empty.

methods.name: on_numpad_event
methods.description: Handles numpad button presses and actions.

methods.name: highlight_numpad_btn
methods.description: Highlights or unhighlights numpad buttons.

methods.name: toggle_numpad
methods.description: Shows or hides numpad.

methods.name: reset_numpad
methods.description: Resets numpad state.

methods.name: toggle_numpad_field_edit
methods.description: Activates numpad for specific field.

methods.name: toggle_customer_info
methods.description: Shows or hides customer info panel.

methods.name: render_customer_fields
methods.description: Creates customer contact fields.

methods.name: fetch_customer_transactions
methods.description: Loads recent customer transactions.

methods.name: attach_refresh_field_event
methods.description: Attaches event to refresh cart items.

methods.name: load_invoice
methods.description: Loads invoice data into cart.

methods.name: toggle_component
methods.description: Shows or hides main component.
